Cancellation & Refund Policy

Last Updated: November 11, 2026

At RealSalePro, operated by Synergy Brand Architect, we are committed to complete transparency, fair pricing, and long-term customer trust. This Cancellation and Refund Policy outlines your rights regarding subscription cancellations, renewals, and refund requests for our real estate CRM software platform.

1. 100% Free Forever Tier (Zero Billing Risk)

RealSalePro offers a fully functional Free Forever Tier supporting up to 1,000 active client leads and up to 5 user accounts. This plan requires no credit card, debit card, or banking details to activate. You may use this tier indefinitely without incurring any charges, fees, or hidden obligations.

2. Paid Subscription Cancellation

  • Self-Service Cancellation: You can cancel your paid Pro subscription at any time directly through your account settings (Dashboard > Settings > Subscription) or by sending an email to support@realsalepro.com.
  • Access Until Period End: When you cancel your subscription, your account remains fully active with all premium features until the end of the current billing cycle (monthly or annual).
  • No Unexpected Renewals: Once canceled, automatic recurring charges are immediately disabled, and no further billing will occur.
  • Seamless Reversion to Free Tier: After your paid term expires, your workspace is downgraded to our Free Forever Tier, preserving your client leads, site visit records, and sales history.

3. Refund Policy for Paid Subscriptions

  • 14-Day Money-Back Window: If you upgrade to a paid plan and decide that RealSalePro does not meet your business requirements, you may request a full refund within 14 calendar days of your initial payment date.
  • Technical Issues & Double Billing: In the unlikely event of duplicate billing, incorrect charges, or severe technical outages that prevent software access, we will issue an immediate 100% refund upon verification.
  • Annual Subscriptions: For annual plans canceled after the 14-day window, a pro-rated refund may be granted upon request, deducting only the standard monthly rate for the active months used.
  • Custom Enterprise Integrations: One-time professional services, custom database setup fees, or dedicated API integration packages are non-refundable once engineering deployment has commenced.

4. Refund Processing Timeline

Approved refunds are initiated immediately and credited to the original payment method (UPI, credit/debit card, or Net Banking via Razorpay) within 5 to 7 business days, subject to your issuing bank's settlement processing timelines.

5. How to Request a Cancellation or Refund

To request a refund or cancel your plan, simply reach out to our team with your registered account email and company name:

Email Desk: support@realsalepro.com

Direct WhatsApp: +91 70797 37773

Support Operating Hours: Monday – Saturday, 9:00 AM – 7:00 PM IST
